proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
proposed.text: Xavier stops Rogue and the X-Men from fighting Spider-Man in his mansion.

their_evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): the mansion's trap catches Spider-Man, the X-Men confront him in the holding chamber, chase him into the Danger Room, and as they surround him Professor Xavier comes in and orders them to stop, then hears him out. Rogue flirts with the captive Spider-Man and joins the chase.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
proposed.text: Jean sees Logan worrying over the missing Beast and reminds him that everyone hides a private pain.

their_evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): Jubilee: "Spider-Man, don't go. He could be a big help to us." Wolverine: "Forget it. He's too much of a loner."

their_evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): the mansion's trap catches Spider-Man, the X-Men confront him in the holding chamber, chase him into the Danger Room, and as they surround him Professor Xavier comes in and orders them to stop, then hears him out. Gambit admits he left the Danger Room running "Deadly Sentinels" and fights them.

question: In Spider-Man (1994)#17-18 the X-Men act as one team (the holding chamber, the Danger Room fight, the Blackbird mission against Landon). Teammates with no exchange of their own (Rogue and Gambit, Jean and Rogue, Jean and Storm, Cyclops and Storm, Gambit and Jubilee) are marked none. Should a shared team scene count as dealing with each other?

stages.title: Loki S1#6
stages.text: Sylvie spends her life running from the TVA and hunts down He Who Remains, its hidden creator, for taking her from her timeline. At the Citadel at the End of Time she ignores his warnings and kills him, splintering the timeline into a multiverse.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who hunts He Who Remains down and kills him at the Citadel.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's hidden creator, whom Sylvie hunts down and kills.

proposed.title: Loki S2#6
proposed.text: As Loki relives the Citadel again and again, Sylvie keeps fighting past him to stab He Who Remains, who taunts her and freezes her in place while Loki looks for another way.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who kills him again and again as Loki relives the Citadel.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's creator, who taunts and freezes Sylvie as Loki relives the Citadel.

their_evidence: Glorious Purpose (Loki S2#6): Loki time slips to just before Sylvie kills He Who Remains; across many loops she fights past Loki and stabs him, He Who Remains taunts her and freezes her in place with his TemPad.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 arrests Loki for the TVA and has no patience for him at first. After learning the TVA's agents are variants, she frees Loki and Sylvie and tosses them weapons to fight Renslayer's guards.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A variant B-15 arrests, then frees to fight Renslayer's guards.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter who arrests Loki, then helps him and Sylvie.

proposed.title: Loki S2#5
proposed.text: After the Loom's explosion resets B-15 to her life as Dr. Verity Willis, Loki finds her on her timeline and brings her to A.D. Doug's workshop to help send everyone back to the TVA.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who finds her living as Verity Willis and brings her to Doug's workshop.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: TVA friend he finds living as Verity Willis and brings back.

their_evidence: Science/Fiction (Loki S2#5): Loki slips to branches where his friends, B-15 among them, live their original lives (she as Dr. Verity Willis) and gathers them at Doug's workshop so their temporal auras can send them back.

stages.title: Loki S1#2
stages.text: When the TVA corners Sylvie at a Roxxcart in 2050 Alabama, she enchants Hunter B-15 and speaks through her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The variant who enchants B-15 at the Roxxcart.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A TVA hunter Sylvie enchants at the Roxxcart.

stages.title: Loki S1#4
stages.text: Sylvie enchants Hunter B-15 at the Roxxcart, and the spell stirs memories of the life B-15 had before the TVA. B-15 later asks Sylvie to show her more, then turns on the TVA and frees Sylvie and Loki in front of Renslayer.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Variant whose enchantment stirs B-15's memories. B-15 later frees her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter Sylvie enchants, who later frees her and Loki.

proposed.title: Loki S2#4
proposed.text: Sylvie works with B-15 at the TVA to save the Loom, and when B-15 reports that Dox and her loyalists are dead, Sylvie realizes Renslayer is behind it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who works with her at the TVA to save the Loom.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter whose news of Dox's death points Sylvie to Renslayer.

their_evidence: Heart of the TVA (Loki S2#4): B-15 finds Dox's loyalists crushed, tells the others, and Sylvie concludes Renslayer is responsible; both are at the Loom when Timely dies.

stages.title: Loki S1#5
stages.text: Miss Minutes helps Renslayer string Sylvie along with a search for a Void timecraft that does not exist, while secretly calling in Minutemen.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Miss Minutes strings along with a fake timecraft.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who strings Sylvie along with a fake timecraft.

stages.title: Loki S1#6
stages.text: Miss Minutes appears to Sylvie and Loki at the Citadel at the End of Time, offering them a deal from He Who Remains.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Miss Minutes strings along with a fake timecraft, then offers a deal.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who strings Sylvie along, then offers He Who Remains' deal.

proposed.title: Loki S2#3
proposed.text: At the 1893 World's Fair, Miss Minutes poses as a ghost clock and chases Sylvie off so Renslayer can escape with Timely. Later Sylvie sends Renslayer through a Timedoor to the Citadel, and Miss Minutes goes along.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Variant she chases off at the World's Fair, who sends her and Renslayer to the Citadel.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who chases Sylvie off at the World's Fair.

their_evidence: 1893 (Loki S2#3): Sylvie is chased off by Miss Minutes posing as the Ghost Clock of Midway, letting Renslayer escape with Timely; at Timely's lab Sylvie sends Renslayer to the Citadel with Miss Minutes brought along.
